items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I was told about Jack Scott--Ernest Scott is his real name... and so I talked with Jack and he was for it... I went to this little gig that they were playing... Teddy wants to join you too.

ctx.x: Where was it held, what ballroom?

It was the ballroom right there on the points, Rosonia. Jones told me, I'll tell you what, Smiling Billy is a long way from Florida, he comes once a year, but he said I'll have you in here a lot of times, and I told him okay. But I told him then, come back again, I think I'll have a different size band, a little larger.

So I went on back then, when we did go back in Tulsa, we played those dates-- what's his name--Dorsey--had several dates and we played around and went back and Spurgeon was still going to school down in Xavier and I never would encourage him to stop school and I think Bostic had Scott around, Earl Bostic, and whenever I couldn't get Spurgeon I'd used
